links.reported_relation: Forcing as little as 1 wei of ETH onto the Slipstream SwapRouter via selfdestruct makes every subsequent swapAndBridgeWithETH/swapAndBridgeWithERC20 call fail.
The victim's swapAndBridge transaction calls exactInput on the Slipstream router, which then attempts to refund its ETH balance to TrustSwapAndBridgeRouter.
Because TrustSwapAndBridgeRouter has no receive/fallback, the ETH refund reverts and the whole swap-and-bridge transaction reverts, making the entry points unusable.
